correctness.rationale: All balanced deletion triples of size three are classified; four exact Laplacian cofactor expressions follow from BEST and P^m=J. The 3-cycle rank-three determinant is given via explicit suffix-prefix overlaps and three residue-class finite geometric sums; each ratio is checked algebraically and with exact integer cofactors for n=3..8. Independent direct Euler tour counts at n=3..5 and enumeration of all deleted triples there verify the boundary, with the zero n=3 case explicitly retained. The all-order conclusion follows from the symbolic determinant, not numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: This resolves the motivated next shortfall after known full, one- and two-window counts. The new closed form is valid for all orders (unlike pre-existing finite tables), classifies the only two possible missing-set mechanisms, reveals sharp n=3 nonexistence for one type and a period-three residue correction, and determines type proportions and total asymptotics. It supplies a natural exact counting invariant for universal cyclic word experiments and constrained sequence generation.
